root.command: SELECT ct.CityID, ct.CityName, nr.PreperationDate, nr.DeliveryDate, nr.NextPreperationDate, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilNextDelivery, DateDiff("d", nr.NextDeliveryDate, Now()) AS DaysSinceNextDelivery FROM CityTbl AS ct INNER JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON ct.CityID = nr.CityID ORDER BY ct.CityName

SELECT ct.CityID, ct.CityName, nr.NextDeliveryDate, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now(), 'PAST - NEEDS UPDATE', 'FUTURE - OK') AS Status FROM CityTbl AS ct INNER JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON ct.CityID = nr.CityID WHERE nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now() ORDER BY ct.CityName

SELECT 'Customers with Past NextDeliveryDate' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now()
